title: Verify 499 new P104 native maps and bind predecessor evidence (no new kappa)
body:
This audit answers the PR5573 handoff for evidence transfer to PR5569. It binds the exact successor word at `af9f091ac6f30c6eaacb9c27777bfbe2d0e5ffdf` to Matarener’s PR5572 full native receipt at `dba3cf67c800f32f04c80437138a51310dc08c1b`.

The successor contains 3,130 distinct operator specifications across 4,189 native occurrences. Exact equality of ordered frames, recipes, literal circuits and ranks permits explicit reuse for 2,631 specifications. All 499 remaining specifications receive fresh comparisons of every matrix column, including absolute phase, unit norm and support rank. Four retained positive controls reproduce the original matrix digests. The receipt names the evidence for every occurrence.

The package preserves exact predecessor files and credits Chris R / Clear1nsight’s dense interpreter, Matarener’s full receipt, GamingPuzzled’s successor, and the DreamingOfClouds, thu-nmrc and Ali Romman P104 lineage. The new binding logic and semantic controls are by Scratch-net with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance.

Scope: finite nine-axis native operators. The 2,631 reused results remain inherited evidence. This is not a fresh replay of the entire predecessor. Complete caller admission, all-width substitution, owned erasure, compiler, precision/tape, stock, funding and analytic obligations remain separate. No new kappa or change to the selected frontier.

Reproduction:

```sh
python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-successor-native-binding
```

The final overlap check found concurrent PR5580 at `6efa248cf456d6101d757e9d09ba29711d18a13a`. This contribution retains the exact PR5569 scope. Transfer to PR5580 is an explicit next question, not an automatic claim.

Validation: CPython 3.12.3/Linux, final normal receipt generation passed in 219.15 seconds. Registered normal and optimized replays passed serially in 365.99 seconds with identical scientific receipts and all 14 controls. Metadata, committed-byte/source-history checks and committed export integrity passed for all 16 files. Optimized replay of the read-only, Git-free committed export passed in 146.61 seconds. All exported bytes remained unchanged. Two input-corruption controls failed authentication before operator replay. Hosted CI is separate.
